description: View from interior hallway of the Indian room at the Abiquiu house looking out into courtyard; interior of an intimate doorway with geometric patterned rug on floor, a narrow plank of wood leans against the wall, a white painted wooden door with a white short curtain opens out into the courtyard, a metal triangle ( possibly a dinner bell) hangs on the outside adobe wall, sunlight falls in linear rows of square patches against the door and on the dirt of the yard - echoing the the pattern of the rug on the floor
title: Fractured Sunlight
